faq.title: What clinics ask before getting started.
faq.subtitle: If your question isn't here, write to us and we'll answer the same day.

items.question: How long does it take to set up Dentiqly?
items.answer: Less than 10 minutes. Sign up, create your clinic and you can start adding patients, configuring services and scheduling appointments. Nothing to install, no technical support to hire.

items.question: Does it work from a phone or tablet?
items.answer: Yes. Dentiqly is 100% web-based: log in from any computer, tablet or phone and see the same information everywhere.

items.question: How do reminders work?
items.answer: From the Reminders screen you pick a day and email a reminder to every patient with an appointment in one click. You write the message.

items.question: Can I migrate the data I already have?
items.answer: Yes. We help you migrate patients, records and appointments from Excel spreadsheets or other systems at no additional cost. Our team guides you through the whole process.

items.question: Can I manage several locations and professionals?
items.answer: Yes. Users and professionals are unlimited, and the Professional plan includes up to 3 locations. From a single panel you see the schedule, metrics and cash flow of every site.

items.question: Is my data and my patients' data secure?
items.answer: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption, SSL/TLS connections and automatic daily backups. Each clinic's data is completely isolated from every other clinic's.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. You get 7 days with full access to every feature, no credit card required. If you don't want to continue, you pay nothing.
